verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an online company-incorporation service, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows the service emailing the generated articles of association (pacto social) and Social Security number, and issuing access codes to the company's electronic card and permanent commercial certificate. These are individual outputs of incorporation, not a documented way to export all of a user's data in open formats. No bulk export, data-format specification or account-departure path is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
